## 8. Models

<!-- models:start (generated by tools/process_models.mjs; edit outside these markers) -->

- **Manga** (`lumenary:manga`, a style that rests on this process): A comic page is printed in black ink on white paper, so every shade has to be built from marks. Manga artists do it with screentone: a sheet of tiny dots or lines stuck on the page and cut away where it is not wanted. Fine dots read as a pale grey, coarse dots… Model: `processes/models/lumenary/manga.json`; theory: `treatments/lumenary/theory/07-painterly.md`.
